rpk: Learners speak the local language at home and learned songs, rhymes, reading and writing basics in Basic 1 and 2.
starter: Greet learners in the local language; sing a familiar local song together.
Revise last lesson's new words with word/picture cards.
NEW TODAY (Week 1): Nnɛ adwuma – sing songs with the correct rhythms and discuss the meaning and moral values of the song
Introduce 3–5 new words (say, meaning, use in a sentence).
main: ACTIVITY 1 (Model – 5 min): Teacher models the skill (talk, read aloud, write on board) – sing songs with the correct rhythms and discuss the meaning and moral values of the song
ACTIVITY 2 (Guided – 5 min): Whole class practises: repeat, answer questions, read or copy together.
ACTIVITY 3 (Pair/Group – 5 min): Pairs/groups do the task in the local language (dialogue, word building, sentence writing) on b3.1.1.
ACTIVITY 4 (Share – 5 min): Groups present; teacher praises good usage and corrects errors gently.
plenary: Exit question: each learner says one new word/sentence in the local language.
Recite today's rhyme/song once more.
Homework: use today's words at home and tell a family member what was learnt.
